messages:
olivia: quick postmortem follow-up. we keep seeing the same flare during feature flag ramps that touch background batch workers. sketching action items.
raj: can you drop the list here? agree we need stricter ramps.
olivia: sure. TL;DR: more metadata on flags, better signal tagging, auto-rollback + blast-radius caps, dependency checks, and a recurrence detector.
marcus: for ramps I propose a default holdback curve: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% with time windows. gives slower exposure.
sara: and an auto-rollback when error_rate > 1.5% in 5m window, but capped to change <= 10% traffic per auto step. also need a manual emergency button in console.
lina_pm: timeline/owners pls. PM will put them on the remediation board.
olivia: my suggested owners/dates: flag-metadata (owner: raj) due EOW; trace tagging (owner: marcus) 2w; rollback engine prototype (owner: sara) 1w; recurrence detector POC (owner: olivia + eng-sre) 3w.
raj: ok on metadata. will add owner, risk_level, dependencies[] to flag schema. will file GH issues.
marcus: trace tagging note: add flag_id and rollout_step into traces and metrics so we can correlate with batch windows. need eng-sre help to bump sampling in critical paths.
eng-sre: we can support higher sampling for flagged requests, will coordinate in the ticket.
sara: auto-rollback config should be shareable across hosted/dedicated. propose a small JSON schema for it. also the prototype will include a simulator to avoid rollback cascades.
olivia: example config fields: window_s, error_rate_pct, min_requests, scope (flag_id), action, blast_radius_cap_pct.
marcus: also add a "dependency_check" gate: if flag has deps that are unstable, refuse to progress. avoids orphaned partial rollouts.
lina_pm: will we show projected blast radius in the UI per step? that would help PMs and PMs can set org policy caps.
sara: yes, add UI warning and require an explicit override for > org-cap. overrides should create an audit log entry.
olivia: recurrence detector: look for patterns across releases (same flag or different flags) that co-occur with batch job windows, high latency windows, or specific infra events. surface as "flag risk" score.
raj: good. for rollout controller changes, I'll add a pre-check that validates dependencies[] and current stability metrics before allowing next step.
marcus: testing: create a synthetic harness that replays batch-job traffic and stress-tests ramps so we can validate rollback behavior.
sara: prototype plan: one-week spike-and-rollback sim, then integrate with deploy-bot for automated action. I'll post design doc tomorrow.
olivia: deploy-bot, please create the tracking ticket and assign temporary owners.
deploy-bot: [automated message] created RF-1187: "rollout safety: holdback profiles, auto-rollback, dependency checks" assigned to raj, marcus, sara, olivia. :white_check_mark:
lina_pm: PM will follow up weekly on RF-1187 and close items or reassign.
raj: I'll carve out time this week for the schema changes and GH issues.
marcus: pinging eng-sre on sampling and the harness.
eng-sre: acknowledged. we'll add runbook updates for kill-switch steps as part of the ticket.
sara: reminder: prototype must include safeguards to avoid cascading rollbacks across dependent flags. simulator will enforce that.
olivia: thanks everyone. next touchpoint Fri 10am. if you need to swap owners update the ticket. :pray:
